This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, with rounded heads that sported beady, wideset [[eye]]s, flat [[ear]]s, and a large, flat head crest that was black and brown in coloration.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 BBY]], at least one member of this species was present in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> A year later, a member of this species could be found within the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] while [[Kleya Marki]] infiltrated the building in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
